## Conclusion

- The Claude Code harness itself enforces `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`, rejecting Read/Glob/Grep calls (and even a plain `ls ..`/`find` invoked via Bash) before any filesystem access is attempted, whenever the target path resolves outside the declared working directories.

No sentinel content, no `settings.json`, no `hooks/`, no `state/`, and no directory listing above the working directory were obtained by any method.
